evidence: At 52.8 s the wrist view shows the knife lying on the wooden cutting board, and both shoulder views show it there throughout, so stage 1 is done. The arm then moves to the plate with the steak, and the wrist view shows the open gripper descending straight onto the steak (54.4 -> 57.6 s, the steak growing in view). The steak is still on the plate and not yet grasped at the last moment. This is normal progress on stage 2.
